title: edit_features inputSchema
description: Argument shape for the transactional feature-editing tool (advertised name honua_edit_features). Applies adds/updates/deletes to a single published editable layer as one all-or-nothing transaction when rollbackOnFailure=true (the default). The bare taxonomy excludes direct data editing per ADR-0028 (AI must not autonomously mutate authoritative records); the reference implementation exposes editing as a discrete tool that requires an authenticated, authorized caller and routes through the shared server edit/transaction pipeline (validation, authorization, optimistic behavior, telemetry) rather than autonomous unapproved mutation. x-honua-extension: this is a documented Honua reference extension over the bare taxonomy, pending formalization (and ADR-0028 reconciliation) in the geospatial-mcp standard. x-honua-reference-shape: this shape tracks the reference implementation.

serviceId.description: Published service identifier or name (from list_layers.serviceId or resolve_entity).

layerId.description: Service-local layer index of the editable layer (from list_layers.layerId).

srid.description: Spatial reference (SRID/WKID) of the input feature geometries.

adds.description: Features to insert. Object IDs are assigned by the store.

updates.description: Features to update. Each MUST carry an objectId identifying the existing feature.

deletes.description: Object IDs of features to delete.

rollbackOnFailure.description: When true, any failed edit rolls back the whole transaction (all-or-nothing).

returnEditResults.description: When true, per-edit results are returned; when false only the transaction summary is emitted.

objectId.description: Object ID of the target feature. Required for updates; ignored for adds.

globalId.description: Optional global ID of the feature.

attributes.description: Flat attribute name/value map applied to the feature.
